# CANDIDATE: NARROW_RANGE_BREAKOUT_RIBBON_ALIGN

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A tight intraday range signals low volatility and potential volatility compression; a breakout in the direction of the EMA ribbon bias captures the ensuing volatility expansion move. This edge exists because low-range periods often precede impulsive moves when liquidity pools are swept, and ribbon alignment confirms institutional bias direction.

## Mechanism

Entry: When today's session high-low range < 0.3 x 20-period ATR AND price breaks above opening range high (long) or below opening range low (short) on close basis AND volume > 1.5 x 20-period average volume AND EMA ribbon (8,21,34,55) all sloping upward (long) or downward (short). Exit: Initial stop at opposite side of opening range (OR low for longs, OR high for shorts); take profit 1 at 1.5R; if price moves favorably, trail runner using chandelier exit at 3 x ATR below highest high (long) or above lowest low (short).
